name: BIM Store
description: BIM STORE: the device library as a web store. Departments, a featured shelf and every maker on the front; a faceted catalogue (department, maker, connector, rack height, data stage, photos) with grid/list, sort and pages; product pages with the front panel drawn in mm, specs (mm, kg, W, BTU/hr), grouped ports, manuals, IFC4/JSON downloads and an Edit in Device Editor link. Reads DATABASE.server.BIM at /api/bim (override with ?api=<url>). No prices: the library keeps none.
